messages:
alex-sales: Quick ask from Meridian POC: they need hosted API keys that rotate automatically every 12h, webhooks for rotate/revoke, IP allowlist, and an audit trail they can push to their Splunk. Can we give a dev-friendly pattern?

kira-eng: Yep. Recommended: short-lived ephemeral keys (TTL=12h), delegated service account that can create/revoke, HMAC-signed webhooks to their endpoint, and per-key usage caps (tokens/day + RPM). We'll include curl and cron examples.

morgan-sec: Security checklist: SSO+MFA for humans, service-account scoped to key:issue,key:revoke only, webhook signing (X-Redwood-Signature), and stream audit events to customer SIEM or export via S3. Recommend TTL<=12h for POCs.

alex-sales: can you paste the minimal snippets to hand them? they want copy-paste for their infra team.

kira-eng: create key example:
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys
Authorization: Bearer <DELEGATED_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "type":"ephemeral", "expires_in":43200, "scopes":["inference:generate"], "note":"meridian-poc-1", "usage_limits":{"tokens_per_day":80000}, "event_webhook":"https://meridian.internal/webhook" }
Response contains key_id and key_value; write key_value to Vault/SecretManager immediately.

kira-eng: revoke example:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <DELEGATED_TOKEN>" -d '{"key_id":"<KEY_ID>","reason":"suspected leak"}'
Revocation enforced at gateway immediately; any further request returns 401. Active streams are cut at next token validation (typically <5s).

morgan-sec: webhook advice: verify HMAC header, use replay window, and implement retry/backoff. We'll provide the signing secret during onboarding. Also require approval for any automation that stores org-admin tokens.

kira-eng: rotation automation pattern: run a scheduled job every 12h that calls create, writes the secret to Vault, updates app, then calls revoke for the previous key once new key propagation is confirmed. Prefer push-to-vault over exposing token in job logs.

rotbot: audit-log: created key meridian-poc-1 by svc-delegate-77 at 1980345679 (simulated).

alex-sales: perfect. I'll draft a one-page playbook: 12h TTL, delegated svc token, HMAC webhooks, IP allowlist, usage caps (80k/day), rotation cron pattern, and emergency revoke steps. Send to Meridian infra and attach process for Splunk event delivery. Thanks! :thumbsup:
